A SENSE OF PLACE

The Brookhaven
connection.

Dresden and Town Brookhaven each offer their own mix of restaurants and shops. Rather than treating Brookhaven as a stop on the way somewhere else, plan the arrival around the neighborhood you want to enjoy. A named restaurant or building makes a better meeting point than a broad district label.
